title: Our History
summary: Company-authored history page stating that Fall Creek was founded in 1978 in Lowell, Oregon and describing its growth from a family nursery into an international blueberry genetics and propagation business.
why_it_matters: Establishes the founding date, founding location and self-described business scope of a primary genetics competitor. Company-authored, so corporate facts are reliable but any performance or market-position language on the page is a claim.

reading.rationale: Baseline corporate facts needed before any competitor assessment can be written.

testing.rationale: Nothing on this page is testable in a trial setting.

commercial_position.rationale: Founding date and scale context inform how the company is positioned against other breeders.

monitoring.rationale: Static corporate history; unlikely to change.
